title: Reimagining the app experience
summary: Concept exploration for Boost Mobile’s next-generation app experience.

sections.label: OVERVIEW
sections.title: Reimagining how Boost members manage their mobile experience.
sections.body: Concept work exploring a clearer, more personal app shell for everyday account tasks.

sections.label: PROBLEM
sections.title: Core flows felt fragmented across legacy screens.
sections.body: Members struggled to find billing, plan, and device actions in one coherent journey.

sections.label: SOLUTION
sections.title: A unified home experience with clearer hierarchy and faster paths to action.
sections.body: Proposed information architecture and high-fidelity concepts for the primary app shell.

sections.label: OUTCOME
sections.title: Direction for future product exploration.
sections.body: Established a visual and interaction direction for continued concept validation.
